setup: Paste BPI_Indicator.pine into the Pine Editor, verify status bar reads Line <lines+1> Col 1, click Add to chart, read the >_ console
expected_result: Compiles and is added to the chart. Record every error and warning verbatim, including any token-limit error
notes: Gate for every other test on this branch. No compilation has been attempted in the Devin environment; there is no offline Pine compiler

settings_summary: Breakers on; structure TF above chart TF
setup: Chart TF below structure TF (e.g. 5m chart / 1h structure)
expected_result: BOS/MSS marks appear only at or after the close of the HTF bar that confirmed the pivot; none sits earlier inside the HTF bar
notes: Primary look-ahead acceptance check (F-01, required category 1)

settings_summary: Breakers on; structure TF = chart TF
setup: Chart TF equal to structure TF (e.g. 1h / 1h)
expected_result: Pivots resolve on the chart's own bars; marks appear brk_rlBars + 1 bars after the pivot bar; lines still draw

settings_summary: Breakers on; structure TF below chart TF
setup: Chart TF above structure TF (e.g. 4h chart / 15m structure)
expected_result: Structure lines invisible (brk_FtfLimit false). Record whether alerts still fire - open defect F-23 predicts they do
notes: Required category 3. Do not assume either outcome; record what happens

setup: Reload the chart (F5) and re-add the indicator on the same symbol and TF
expected_result: Mark positions identical to the previous load

settings_summary: Baseline build and fixed build on one chart
setup: audit-baseline-20260916 saved as a second script, both added to the same chart
expected_result: Fixed build's marks are at or later than baseline's, never earlier. Record mark counts for both
notes: Counts may differ in either direction - the state machine can take a different path. That is expected, not a failure

setup: Bar Replay from ~200 bars back, stepping bar by bar
expected_result: Each mark appears at the same bar it occupies on the fully loaded historical chart
notes: Required category 5. Divergence means look-ahead remains

setup: Bar Replay from the same start point
expected_result: Expected to diverge from its own historical chart
notes: Documents the pre-fix defect. If it does not diverge, F-01's severity needs revisiting

setup: Deep scroll-back on a liquid symbol (maximum practical history)
expected_result: No runtime error, no drawing-limit message, marks still present at the far left

setup: Live session; watch an open candle that breaks structure
expected_result: No notification while the candle is open
notes: Required category 6 (F-09). Needs a live market; Bar Replay cannot reproduce intrabar ticks

setup: Live session; the same candle closes with the break still valid
expected_result: Exactly one notification, at or just after the close

setup: Open candle breaks structure, then price retraces before the close
expected_result: Record actual behavior. BOS uses the bar's high/low, which do not retrace, so a wick break may still alert at the close
notes: The fix removes the early notification, not the wick sensitivity

setup: Live session; multiple Breakers conditions satisfied on one candle
expected_result: No duplicate notification for the same signal on the same bar

settings_summary: alertcondition alert, frequency Once Per Bar Close

expected_result: One notification at the bar close
notes: Frequency is the user's choice; the script cannot force it

settings_summary: alertcondition alert, frequency Once Per Bar

expected_result: Fires intrabar
notes: Expected. Must be covered in customer setup instructions

settings_summary: MSS mode Body Only, then Body / Wick

expected_result: Body Only compares against the confirmed HTF close and should not flip mid-candle; Body / Wick uses live high/low and can
